```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Functions defined here
# copied from https://rdrr.io/bioc/imageHTS/man/zprime.html

zprime = function(a, b, method=c('mahalanobis', 'robust', 'fixsd', 'original')) {
    method = match.arg(method)
    
    if (method=='mahalanobis') {
        if (is.null(dim(a))) a = matrix(a, ncol=1)
        if (is.null(dim(b))) b = matrix(b, ncol=1)
        mua = apply(a, 2, mean)
        mub = apply(b, 2, mean)
        dm = try(mahalanobis(mua, mub, cov(a) + cov(b)))
        if (class(dm)=='try-error') NA
        else 1-3/sqrt(dm)
    }
    else {
        if (method=='robust') 1-3*(mad(a)+mad(b))/abs(median(a)-median(b))
        else if (method=='fixsd') 1-3*sqrt(var(a)+var(b))/abs(mean(a)-mean(b))
        else 1-3*(sd(a)+sd(b))/abs(mean(a)-mean(b))
    }
}


investigate_raw_maps <- function(to_plot, request){
    request <- eval(request)
    request <- quo_name(enquo(request))
    
    raw_map(data = to_plot[[request]], 
            well = to_plot$well, 
            plate = 96) + labs(title = request)
}
```

```{r loessforreal}
# OK OK. LOESS THEN Z SCORE

loess_dataset <- final_plate_list

variables_of_interest <- setdiff(colnames(final_plate_list), c( "well", "Row", "Column", "gene"))

rownames(loess_dataset) <- make.unique(loess_dataset$gene)

loess_models <- lapply(variables_of_interest, function(x) {
    loess(as.formula(paste0("`",x,"`", " ~ Row + Column")),
          data = loess_dataset,
          span = 1,  # Adjust?
          degree = 1)    # Linear fit recommended for spatial patterns
})

names(loess_models) <- variables_of_interest

loess_fits <- lapply(variables_of_interest, function(y) {
    loess_models[[y]]["fitted"]
}) 
names(loess_fits) <- variables_of_interest


loess_results <- lapply(variables_of_interest, function(z){
    loess_models[[z]][["y"]]-(loess_fits[[z]][["fitted"]]-median(loess_fits[[z]][["fitted"]]))
})

names(loess_results) <- variables_of_interest

df_loess_results <- data.table(do.call(bind_cols, loess_results))

df_loess_results <- bind_cols(df_loess_results, loess_dataset %>% dplyr::select(c("Row", "Column", "well", "gene")))


### Visualise the loessing if need:
# not fully corrected
# raw_map(data = final_plate_list$`Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Median per Well`,
#         well = final_plate_list$well,
#         plate = 96)
# 
# 
# raw_map(data = df_loess_results[df_loess_results$plate == "P1_SIMA_V1.txt"] %>% dplyr::select(`Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Median per Well`),
#         well = df_loess_results[df_loess_results$plate == "P1_SIMA_V1.txt"] %>% dplyr::select(well),
#         plate = 96)



### Z scores per plate on loess normalised data
variables_of_interest <- setdiff(colnames(df_loess_results), c("well","Row","Column","gene"))

which_plate <- unique(df_loess_results)

all_plate_z_scores <- data.table()

for (j in seq_along(which_plate)) {
    
    # test
    #print(which_plate[j])
    
    ### SUBSET DATA TO PLATE LEVEL FOR Z-SCORE CALCULATIONS
    temp_plate_list <- df_loess_results 
    
    ### BEGIN 2ND LOOP FOR Z SCORE CALCS
    
    
    for (i in seq_along(variables_of_interest)) {
        
        #print(variables_of_interest[i])
        
        temp_var <- variables_of_interest[i]
        
        ### First get the mean and stdev which can change per iteration
        mean_NTC_var <- mean(temp_plate_list[[temp_var]]) # mean of variable across all genes
        stdev_var <- sd(temp_plate_list[[temp_var]]) # standard deviation for var across all genes
        
        
        ### Then get the Z-score
        temp_plate_list <- temp_plate_list %>%
            mutate(
                !!paste0(temp_var,"_z_score") := ( (.data[[temp_var]] - mean_NTC_var) / stdev_var)
            ) # this madness is needed for strings to become variable names
        ### Then the Sigma Z score
        assign(paste0("`",temp_var,"sigma_z_score","`"), sd(temp_plate_list[[paste0(temp_var,"_z_score")]][str_detect(temp_plate_list$gene, "NTC")]))
        #print(eval(as.name(paste0("`",temp_var,"sigma_z_score","`")), envir= .GlobalEnv)) #debugging
        
        ### Then the effect sizes
        temp_plate_list <- temp_plate_list %>%
            mutate(
                !!paste0(temp_var,"effect_size") := .data[[paste0(temp_var,"_z_score")]] /eval(as.name(paste0("`",temp_var,"sigma_z_score","`")), envir= .GlobalEnv)
            )
        
    }
    
    ### ONCE ALL CALCULATED BIND ONTO PREVIOUS RESULTS
    all_plate_z_scores <- bind_rows(all_plate_z_scores, temp_plate_list)
    
}
```

```{r anovas}


z_scores_post_loess_only <- all_plate_z_scores %>% 
    dplyr::select(contains("z_score"), gene, Row, Column, well, plate)

pca_plot_data <- z_scores_post_loess_only %>%  filter(gene != "Empty")


### spot count

spot_count_df <- data.frame(spot_count = pca_plot_data$cell_width_to_length_z_score,
                            gene = pca_plot_data$gene) #pca_plot_data$`Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Mean per Well_z_score`

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result_sc <- aov(spot_count ~ gene, data = spot_count_df)
summary(anova_result_sc)

plot(anova_result_sc)


# Use the Dunnett's test because Tukey compares everything to everything
# meaning for our case of 70 genes +5 controls, 75C2 = 2775

library(DescTools)
sc_ctrl <- DunnettTest(x=spot_count_df$spot_count, g=spot_count_df$gene, control = "NTC3")
dunnett_summary_sc <- as.data.frame(sc_ctrl$NTC3) %>% 
    mutate(comparisons = rownames(.))

###

ds_sc <- dunnett_summary_sc %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "contrast") %>%
    #extract the tested group name (the part before or after the dash; adjust if needed)
    mutate(group = str_split_fixed(contrast, "-", 2)[,1], control = str_split_fixed(contrast, "-", 2)[,2]) %>%
    #order for plotting
    dplyr::arrange(diff) %>% mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = contrast))
#add a simple significance label

ds_sc <- ds_sc %>% mutate(sig = case_when( pval < 0.05 ~ "TRUE", .default="FALSE" ))


ggplot(ds_sc, aes(x = diff, y = contrast)) + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lwr.ci, xmax = upr.ci), height = 0.25, color = "grey30") +
    geom_point(aes(color = pval < 0.05), size = 2) +
    #geom_text(aes(label = sig), hjust = -0.3, vjust = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "red")) +
    labs(x = "Difference vs NTC3 (diff)", y = "",
         color = "Significant",
         title = "Dunnett test estimates and 95% CI - Cell width to length") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))
```

```{r bigchunk}

# library(dplyr)
# library(tidyr)
# library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Settings
# ------------------------------------------------------------

reference_gene <- "NTC3"

# NULL includes all retained genes.
# Otherwise, replace NULL with your exact gene names:
# genes_to_compare <- c("IRS1", "PTEN", "POLA1", "PPARG")
# NTC3 is always included automatically.
genes_to_compare <- NULL

exclude_empty_wells <- TRUE

ellipse_level <- 0.20
point_size <- 1.5
point_alpha <- 0.6
label_genes <- TRUE

metadata_cols <- c( "well", "Row", "Column", "gene")

# Change the displayed label without changing gene identities.
display_gene <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    ifelse(x == reference_gene, "NTC", x)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Input checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

loess_dataset <- as.data.frame(final_plate_list)

missing_metadata <- setdiff(metadata_cols, names(loess_dataset))

if (length(missing_metadata) > 0L) {
    stop(
        "Missing metadata columns: ",
        paste(missing_metadata, collapse = ", ")
    )
}


loess_dataset$gene <- trimws(as.character(loess_dataset$gene))

if (exclude_empty_wells) {
    loess_dataset <- loess_dataset %>%
        filter(tolower(gene) != "empty")
}

if (nrow(loess_dataset) == 0L) {
    stop("No wells remain for analysis.")
}


if (!is.numeric(loess_dataset$Row) ||
    !is.numeric(loess_dataset$Column)) {
    stop("Row and Column must be numeric.")
}

variables_of_interest <- setdiff(
    names(loess_dataset),
    metadata_cols
)

if (length(variables_of_interest) == 0L) {
    stop("No measurement columns were found.")
}

numeric_measurements <- vapply(
    loess_dataset[variables_of_interest],
    is.numeric,
    logical(1)
)

if (!all(numeric_measurements)) {
    stop(
        "Non-numeric measurement columns: ",
        paste(
            variables_of_interest[!numeric_measurements],
            collapse = ", "
        )
    )
}

if (!any(loess_dataset$gene == reference_gene)) {
    stop("No wells match reference_gene: ", reference_gene)
}

if (is.null(genes_to_compare)) {
    selected_genes <- unique(loess_dataset$gene)
} else {
    selected_genes <- unique(c(
        reference_gene,
        trimws(as.character(genes_to_compare))
    ))
}

missing_genes <- setdiff(selected_genes, loess_dataset$gene)

if (length(missing_genes) > 0L) {
    stop(
        "Requested genes were not found: ",
        paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", ")
    )
}

# NTC appears first in the PCA legend and at the top of flipped plots.
gene_levels <- c(
    reference_gene,
    sort(setdiff(selected_genes, reference_gene))
)

box_gene_levels <- rev(gene_levels)

gene_colours <- setNames(
    c(
        "#B31B21",
        grDevices::hcl.colors(
            length(gene_levels) - 1L,
            palette = "Dark 3"
        )
    ),
    gene_levels
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. LOESS correction using all retained wells on the plate
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df_loess_results <- loess_dataset

for (temp_var in variables_of_interest) {

    fit_data <- data.frame(
        value = loess_dataset[[temp_var]],
        Row = loess_dataset$Row,
        Column = loess_dataset$Column
    )

    valid <- with(
        fit_data,
        is.finite(value) &
            is.finite(Row) &
            is.finite(Column)
    )

    corrected <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(fit_data))

    if (sum(valid) < 6L ||
        length(unique(fit_data$Row[valid])) < 2L ||
        length(unique(fit_data$Column[valid])) < 2L) {

        warning(
            "Insufficient spatial data for ", temp_var,
            "; corrected values set to NA."
        )

    } else {

        fit <- stats::loess(
            value ~ Row + Column,
            data = fit_data[valid, , drop = FALSE],
            span = 1,
            degree = 1,
            normalize = FALSE,
            na.action = stats::na.fail
        )

        fitted_values <- as.numeric(fit$fitted)

        if (any(!is.finite(fitted_values))) {
            stop("Non-finite LOESS fitted values for: ", temp_var)
        }

        corrected[valid] <- fit_data$value[valid] -
            (fitted_values - median(fitted_values))
    }

    df_loess_results[[temp_var]] <- corrected
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Whole-plate z-scores for PCA
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_plate_z_scores <- df_loess_results
z_score_cols <- paste0(variables_of_interest, "_z_score")

if (any(z_score_cols %in% names(df_loess_results))) {
    stop("Generated z-score names overlap existing input columns.")
}

for (i in seq_along(variables_of_interest)) {

    x <- df_loess_results[[variables_of_interest[i]]]
    valid <- is.finite(x)
    z <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))

    if (sum(valid) >= 2L) {
        plate_sd <- sd(x[valid])

        if (is.finite(plate_sd) && plate_sd > 0) {
            z[valid] <- (x[valid] - mean(x[valid])) / plate_sd
        }
    }

    all_plate_z_scores[[z_score_cols[i]]] <- z
}

z_scores_post_loess_only <- all_plate_z_scores %>%
    filter(gene %in% selected_genes) %>%
    select(all_of(z_score_cols), gene)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. NTC3 reference statistics and effect scores
# ------------------------------------------------------------

measurement_long <- df_loess_results %>%
    filter(gene %in% selected_genes) %>%
    select(all_of(c(metadata_cols, variables_of_interest))) %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = all_of(variables_of_interest),
        names_to = "measurement",
        values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        value = if_else(is.finite(value), value, NA_real_)
    )

reference_stats <- measurement_long %>%
    filter(gene == reference_gene) %>%
    group_by( measurement) %>%
    summarise(
        n_reference = sum(!is.na(value)),
        reference_mean = if (n_reference > 0L) {
            mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
            NA_real_
        },
        reference_sd = if (n_reference >= 2L) {
            sd(value, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
            NA_real_
        },
        .groups = "drop"
    )

# One standardised deviation per well:
# (well value - NTC3 mean) / NTC3 SD.
# These are well-level scores, not individual Glass's deltas.
well_effect_scores <- measurement_long %>%
    left_join(reference_stats, by = c( "measurement")) %>%
    mutate(
        standardised_deviation = if_else(
            is.finite(value) &
                n_reference >= 2L &
                is.finite(reference_mean) &
                is.finite(reference_sd) & reference_sd > 0,
            (value - reference_mean) / reference_sd,
            NA_real_
        )
    )

# Conventional Glass's delta: one value per gene and measurement.
all_plate_effect_sizes <- measurement_long %>%
    group_by( gene, measurement) %>%
    summarise(
        n_wells = sum(!is.na(value)),
        gene_mean = if (n_wells > 0L) {
            mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
            NA_real_
        },
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(reference_stats, by = c("measurement")) %>%
    mutate(
        glass_delta = if_else(
            n_wells > 0L &
                n_reference >= 2L &
                is.finite(gene_mean) &
                is.finite(reference_mean) &
                is.finite(reference_sd) & reference_sd > 0,
            (gene_mean - reference_mean) / reference_sd,
            NA_real_
        )
    )

if (any(!is.finite(all_plate_effect_sizes$glass_delta))) {
    warning(
        "Some effects are unavailable. Check n_wells, ",
        "n_reference and reference_sd in all_plate_effect_sizes."
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Well-level boxplots and gene-level Glass's delta plots
# ------------------------------------------------------------

well_boxplots <- list()
glass_delta_plots <- list()

for (selected_measurement in variables_of_interest) {

    single_plot_data <- well_effect_scores %>%
        filter(
            measurement == selected_measurement,
            is.finite(standardised_deviation)
        ) %>%
        mutate(
            gene = factor(gene, levels = box_gene_levels),
            gene_type = if_else(
                as.character(gene) == reference_gene,
                "NTC",
                "Other genes"
            )
        )

    if (nrow(single_plot_data) == 0L) {
        warning("No valid effects to plot for: ", selected_measurement)
        next
    }

    ntc_values <- single_plot_data$standardised_deviation[
        as.character(single_plot_data$gene) == reference_gene
    ]

    ntc_median <- median(ntc_values)

    p <- ggplot(
        single_plot_data,
        aes(
            x = gene,
            y = standardised_deviation,
            group = gene
        )
    ) +
        geom_hline(
            yintercept = 0,
            colour = "grey70",
            linetype = "dashed"
        ) +
        geom_boxplot(
            aes(colour = gene_type),
            outlier.shape = NA
        ) +
        geom_point(
            position = position_jitter(
                width = 0.15,
                height = 0,
                seed = 1
            ),
            alpha = point_alpha,
            size = point_size
        ) +
        geom_hline(
            yintercept = ntc_median,
            colour = "#B31B21",
            linetype = "dotted",
            linewidth = 0.8
        ) +
        scale_colour_manual(
            values = c(
                "NTC" = "#B31B21",
                "Other genes" = "#1465AC"
            ),
            name = "Gene type"
        ) +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = display_gene) +
        coord_flip() +
        labs(
            title = selected_measurement,
            subtitle = paste(
                "Red dotted line: NTC well-score median =",
                signif(ntc_median, 3)
            ),
            x = "Gene",
            y = "Well deviation from NTC mean (NTC SD units)"
        ) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
        )

    well_boxplots[[selected_measurement]] <- p
    print(p)

    # One Glass's delta per gene: display points rather than boxes.
    delta_data <- all_plate_effect_sizes %>%
        filter(
            measurement == selected_measurement,
            is.finite(glass_delta)
        ) %>%
        mutate(
            gene = factor(gene, levels = box_gene_levels)
        )

    delta_plot <- ggplot(
        delta_data,
        aes(x = gene, y = glass_delta, colour = gene)
    ) +
        geom_hline(
            yintercept = 0,
            colour = "grey70",
            linetype = "dashed"
        ) +
        geom_point(size = 3) +
        scale_colour_manual(
            values = gene_colours,
            guide = "none"
        ) +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = display_gene) +
        coord_flip() +
        labs(
            title = selected_measurement,
            subtitle = "One gene-level effect per gene on this plate",
            x = "Gene",
            y = "Glass's delta vs NTC"
        ) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
        )

    glass_delta_plots[[selected_measurement]] <- delta_plot
    print(delta_plot)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Matched PCA inputs for selected genes
#    LOESS preserves row order, so both matrices use the same rows.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

selected_rows <- which(loess_dataset$gene %in% selected_genes)

before_matrix <- as.matrix(
    loess_dataset[
        selected_rows,
        variables_of_interest,
        drop = FALSE
    ]
)

after_matrix <- as.matrix(
    all_plate_z_scores[
        selected_rows,
        z_score_cols,
        drop = FALSE
    ]
)

colnames(after_matrix) <- variables_of_interest

has_variation <- function(x) {
    x <- x[is.finite(x)]
    length(x) >= 2L && is.finite(sd(x)) && sd(x) > 0
}

keep_columns <- apply(before_matrix, 2, has_variation) &
    apply(after_matrix, 2, has_variation)

if (any(!keep_columns)) {
    message(
        "Excluded PCA measurements: ",
        paste(colnames(before_matrix)[!keep_columns], collapse = ", ")
    )
}

before_matrix <- before_matrix[, keep_columns, drop = FALSE]
after_matrix <- after_matrix[, keep_columns, drop = FALSE]

if (ncol(before_matrix) < 2L) {
    stop("PCA requires at least two usable measurements.")
}

keep_rows <- rowSums(!is.finite(before_matrix)) == 0 &
    rowSums(!is.finite(after_matrix)) == 0

message(
    "PCA: excluding ", sum(!keep_rows),
    " selected wells with missing/non-finite measurements."
)

before_matrix <- before_matrix[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
after_matrix <- after_matrix[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]

pca_metadata <- loess_dataset[
    selected_rows[keep_rows],
    c( "well", "gene"),
    drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(pca_metadata) < 3L) {
    stop("PCA requires at least three complete selected wells.")
}

# Recheck variability after removing incomplete wells.
keep_columns <- apply(before_matrix, 2, has_variation) &
    apply(after_matrix, 2, has_variation)

before_matrix <- before_matrix[, keep_columns, drop = FALSE]
after_matrix <- after_matrix[, keep_columns, drop = FALSE]

if (ncol(before_matrix) < 2L) {
    stop("Too few variable measurements remain for PCA.")
}

missing_pca_genes <- setdiff(selected_genes, pca_metadata$gene)

if (length(missing_pca_genes) > 0L) {
    warning(
        "No complete PCA wells remain for: ",
        paste(missing_pca_genes, collapse = ", ")
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Fit PCAs and extract scores
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pca_before <- prcomp(
    before_matrix,
    center = TRUE,
    scale. = TRUE
)

pca_after <- prcomp(
    after_matrix,
    center = TRUE,
    scale. = TRUE
)

make_scores <- function(pca_object, metadata) {
    metadata %>%
        mutate(
            gene = factor(gene, levels = gene_levels),
            PC1 = pca_object$x[, 1],
            PC2 = pca_object$x[, 2]
        )
}

before_scores <- make_scores(pca_before, pca_metadata)
after_scores <- make_scores(pca_after, pca_metadata)

axis_labels <- function(pca_object) {
    variance_percent <- 100 * pca_object$sdev^2 /
        sum(pca_object$sdev^2)

    list(
        x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", variance_percent[1]),
        y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", variance_percent[2])
    )
}

padded_range <- function(x) {
    limits <- range(x, finite = TRUE)
    padding <- diff(limits) * 0.05

    if (padding == 0) {
        padding <- 1
    }

    limits + c(-padding, padding)
}

shared_x_limits <- padded_range(
    c(before_scores$PC1, after_scores$PC1)
)

shared_y_limits <- padded_range(
    c(before_scores$PC2, after_scores$PC2)
)

get_ellipse_data <- function(scores) {
    scores %>%
        group_by(gene) %>%
        filter(
            n() >= 4L &&
                qr(
                    cbind(
                        PC1 - mean(PC1),
                        PC2 - mean(PC2)
                    )
                )$rank == 2L
        ) %>%
        ungroup()
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Gene-coloured PCA plots only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_gene_pca_plot <- function(scores, pca_object, plot_title) {

    axes <- axis_labels(pca_object)
    ellipse_scores <- get_ellipse_data(scores)

    gene_centres <- scores %>%
        group_by(gene) %>%
        summarise(
            PC1 = mean(PC1),
            PC2 = mean(PC2),
            .groups = "drop"
        )

    p <- ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = gene)) +
        geom_point(
            alpha = point_alpha,
            size = point_size
        ) +
        scale_colour_manual(
            values = gene_colours,
            limits = gene_levels,
            breaks = gene_levels,
            labels = display_gene,
            drop = FALSE,
            name = "Gene"
        ) +
        labs(
            title = plot_title,
            subtitle = paste0(
                round(ellipse_level * 100),
                "% normal data ellipses where estimable"
            ),
            x = axes$x,
            y = axes$y
        ) +
        coord_equal(
            xlim = shared_x_limits,
            ylim = shared_y_limits,
            expand = FALSE
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
        theme(
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "right"
        ) +
        guides(
            colour = guide_legend(
                override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)
            )
        )

    if (nrow(ellipse_scores) > 0L) {
        p <- p +
            stat_ellipse(
                data = ellipse_scores,
                aes(group = gene),
                type = "norm",
                level = ellipse_level,
                linewidth = 0.7,
                show.legend = FALSE
            )
    }

    if (label_genes) {
        p <- p +
            geom_label_repel(
                data = gene_centres,
                aes(label = display_gene(gene)),
                fill = "white",
                seed = 1,
                max.overlaps = Inf,
                show.legend = FALSE
            )
    }

    p
}

pca_all_genes_before <- make_gene_pca_plot(
    before_scores,
    pca_before,
    "Before LOESS correction — selected genes"
)

pca_all_genes_after <- make_gene_pca_plot(
    after_scores,
    pca_after,
    "After LOESS correction — selected genes"
)

print(pca_all_genes_before)
print(pca_all_genes_after)

```
